projectContext: Sprint 25 continues test infrastructure maturity after Sprint 24 completed subdirectory READMEs, flaky test infrastructure, benchmark CI config, test helpers module, and coverage scripts. This sprint focuses on: (1) helpers/fixtures README documentation, (2) expanding parametrize usage to 50+ new cases, (3) marking 200+ network-dependent tests as flaky, (4) adding agent healer assertion helpers, (5) enabling benchmark CI regression detection, (6) consolidating duplicate test patterns, and (7) improving marker coverage from 25% to 50%.

userStories.title: Add agent healer assertion helpers to tests/helpers
userStories.notes: Implemented 4 healer assertion helpers with full test coverage (32 new tests). assert_healer_attempt_logged() validates healer logging with attempt_num and expected_message options. assert_healing_strategy_applied() validates strategy mode with optional check_max_attempts and check_heal_delay params. assert_recovery_metrics_valid() validates HealingMetrics with expected_attempts, expected_success, min_successful_heals, max_failed_heals, expected_healers_used, expected_stages_healed options. assert_healer_chain_executed() validates healer chain with in_order and all_required options. Added VALID_HEALERS and VALID_STRATEGIES constants. Updated README.md with comprehensive documentation and usage examples.

userStories.title: Enable benchmark regression detection in CI workflow
userStories.notes: Created .github/workflows/benchmarks.yml with: (1) Weekly schedule (Sundays midnight UTC) + push triggers on benchmark file changes + manual workflow_dispatch; (2) Baseline comparison using benchmark_runner.py --compare with configurable threshold (default 20%); (3) Artifact upload for results (90-day retention) and baseline (365-day retention); (4) Job summary with regression warnings; (5) Manual update_baseline and threshold override inputs. Updated tests/benchmarks/README.md with GitHub Actions workflow documentation section.
